examples: The Spark and the mini are both unreachable while conversations close: a red badge appears on the bell beside the Carnivore mark in the agents drawer, a card says no summary server reachable, and the panel shows how many summaries are waiting. The alert resolves by itself on the first summary that succeeds.
You already know a server is down: dismiss the alert and it stays quiet until the condition clears, or snooze it for an hour.
You want a Slack message when the save pipeline stops, but no pop-up card: tick save pipeline under the Slack destination and untick it on screen.
how_to: Click the bell beside the Carnivore mark in the agents drawer (or under the claw of the closed drawer's icon rail): open alerts first, errors before warnings, each with its count and first and last seen; resolved alerts of the last 24 hours fold underneath. On a phone with the drawer shut, a coloured dot on the claw says an alert is open; tap the claw, then the bell. Clicking any alert card opens the panel too.
Dismiss, snooze 1h, or clear resolved from the panel; each is a route: POST /api/v1/alerts/{id}/dismiss, POST /api/v1/alerts/{id}/snooze {minutes}, POST /api/v1/alerts/dismiss-resolved.
GET /api/v1/alerts?state=active|all for the list and the badge counts; changes also arrive on /ws/events as app_alert.raised, app_alert.updated and app_alert.resolved.
An alert card can be hidden per type: untick that alert's row in the screen column of the routing matrix. The bell and the panel still list it.

Alerts can also be routed to outside destinations (chat, push, email, sms): tick the alert rows (self check, save pipeline, archive, transcripts, account, phone link) under a destination in the matrix.
media_exempt: A drawer bell and popup whose screenshots are captured before the next version bump.
name: Alert center
summary: one place for app health: any part of the app can raise a deduplicated alert with a severity, and the bell in the agents drawer shows the count, a panel lists them, and every newly raised alert raises a card coloured by its severity.
where: The bell beside the Carnivore mark in the agents drawer's header, and under the claw of the closed drawer's icon rail; on a phone, a severity dot on the claw that opens the drawer. Shown once signed in. API under /api/v1/alerts.
